description: elementary files not judged by a more specific rule can be updated under ALWays, where the standards give PIN, ADM or NEVer
reference: ETSI TS 102 221 clause 9.2 (access rules); 3GPP TS 31.102 clause 4
remediation: set each listed file's UPDATE access rule (its EF.ARR record) to PIN or ADM as the standard or the operator profile requires; confirm a proprietary file is meant to be world-writable, then re-scan
